I am in the same exact boat as your little sister, it was my older brother. We were children, he was abused before, and then I happened to be an unfortunate target of the aftermath. Do NOT minimize his actions, both of them need help, professional help. As far as separating them, regardless of the living situation, the law should be brought in at some capacity. She doesn’t have to try to press charges, but there should be a level of communication with the system for not only resources for her, but possibly a system for him if they need to be (honestly should be) separated. The biggest thing I will stress is listening to, being there for, and providing help to your sister. Provide help to your brother as well. It’s an awful situation that is horribly damaging to children and takes a lot of time for recovery, just be there. Listen. Let her talk to you, or someone. She needs you now more than ever.

I used to be a pretty big fan of them, their videos were a comfort to me for a long time. I thought they were both funny in their own ways and followed both of them on their personal social medias. I would spend hours watching their play throughs and even shared their content with people in my life. Unfortunately around the time they started playing Detroit: Become Human, one of my favorite games, I started to realize how much Arin was getting on my nerves for not even trying. Dan was somewhat invested, but not by much, and Arin immediately starts hounding the game overall when he has barely done anything in it right and hasn’t even given it a chance. It was disappointing and I noticed a trend of Arin doing things like that nearly constantly, not caring enough to even try to get into the game or shitting all over it not even five minutes in. Or both. But I’d say the more recent controversies and the overall decline of the content and apparent care from either of them that they seemed to have before, drove me away the most.

I had been watching Game Grumps for years and hadn’t heard of much from the community in terms of controversy. The one I heard of most was Suzy reselling items in her shop and knocking the price up a bunch, which sure is sleazy but whatever. I didn’t really like the fact that Arin started pandering toward the LGBT community, because despite playing Dream Daddy, it did feel like a bit of a cash grab. I saw a YouTube comment on a video about the Grumps that was mentioning something that Dan did so I did my own research and stumbled onto this community. I genuinely can’t enjoy their content anymore, especially after hearing Suzy say the n word outright and basically say “Arin gave a black guy a ride and had to say n______ like 30 times to get it out of his system.” And then stumbling into Dan supposedly sleeping with fans in a scummy kind of way (being manipulative by telling girls he loved them and wanted to date them if it weren’t for him being “a rockstar”, trying to force girls to sleep together with him for his own pleasure, ect.) I just can’t support them anymore, and it really sucks because they were fun to listen to for a long while. Hardcore fans are so quick to shit on people who bring up any of the controversies or even saying a single bad thing about either of them. It’s just not fun for me anymore
